content:
nina: CI alert - SAST verification step started failing after last night's KMS rotation, error shows kms.Decrypt AccessDenied
sam: I see multiple jobs failed around 14:10 UTC, likely service account lost decrypter role
deploy-bot: [alert] 3234567900 - ci/sast-verify failed - error=kms.Decrypt: AccessDenied - job=ci.sast.451
sec-oncall: paste exact log and key alias please
nina: log: `2026-03-21T14:11:03Z verify: artifact=lib-core sig=abcd id=job-451 kms:Decrypt error: AccessDenied for projects/redwood/keys/prod-signing`
leo: checking rotation change - rotation PR replaced principals; looks like `scanner-service@...` was removed (typo: scanner_serv vs scanner-service)
sam: that explains it. options: re-grant role, rollback key rotation, or use temporary CI grant.
sec-oncall: re-grant for unblock, open incident for postmortem. mark as security-impacting change.
sam: applied grant: `roles/cloudkms.decrypter` to scanner-service for 45m (audit=aud-3234567912)
deploy-bot: [audit] iam.policy.change user=sam time=3234567912 action=add-iam-policy-binding resource=projects/redwood/keys/prod-signing
nina: CI retry is green ✅
leo: i'll own the follow-up: (1) patch rotation script to validate exact IAM bindings, (2) add unit test/dry-run, (3) add CI gate post-rotation.
sec-oncall: filing INC-2026-03-KMS-ROT-02, sev=P2, owner=leo. postmortem due tomorrow EOD.
